name: My Sister
source:
In a universe that is definitely not ours, there is a girl called Mai Sister.

Mai Sister loves to stab people because they are so damn annoying and she is only being stop by the idea of being executed. 

One day, when humans got too irritating... HAHAHA!

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29876]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
在一个绝对不属于我们的宇宙里，有一个叫麦姐的女孩。

麦姐喜欢刺人，因为刺人太烦人了，她只有被处决的想法才停下来。

有一天，人类变得太烦人了……哈哈哈！
